name: io.github.eukosh/youtube-kit
title: youtube-kit
description: Your YouTube channels for agents: analytics, uploads, metadata, playlists and comment moderation.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: Channel to work on by default (UC... ID, @handle or exact title), from the ones logged in with `ytk auth login`

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for public data; without one, public reads go through your login
